description: React component for managing cluster settings in Mattermost admin console, including high availability configuration, cluster name, hostname override, gossip protocol settings, and related warnings.

classes.name: ClusterSettings
classes.description: React component extending OLDAdminSettings, managing cluster configuration UI and logic for Mattermost admin console.

methods.name: getConfigFromState
methods.description: Constructs and returns AdminConfig object based on current component state.

methods.name: getStateFromConfig
methods.description: Initializes component state from given AdminConfig object.

methods.name: renderTitle
methods.description: Renders the title of the settings section.

methods.name: overrideHandleChange
methods.description: Handles change events, sets warning flag, and updates state.

methods.name: renderSettings
methods.description: Renders the cluster settings UI, including warnings, configuration inputs, and conditional components.
